Stage 2b: Chinese-remainder decomposition checks and the principality question for right ideals.
Stage 2c: Galois-duality computations for the theta_s pairing, including the non-principal cases.
Stage 3a: structure of Galois hulls - dimensions, minimal generator numbers and the mu_B = 3 witnesses.
Stage 3b: exhaustive enumeration of hulls in the small families, giving the counts reported in the manuscript.
Checks that the coefficient-expansion (Gray) map transports the Galois pairing to the explicit form over F_q claimed in the manuscript.
